changeSet.sql: CREATE SCHEMA IF NOT EXISTS rule_management

changeSet.author: paypulse
changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE rule_management.fraud_rule ( id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(), name VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL UNIQUE, enabled BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT true, json_spec JSONB NOT NULL, version BIGINT NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ(3) NOT NULL DEFAULT (timezone('utc', now())) )

changeSet.author: paypulse
changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE rule_management.outbox ( id BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY, partitioning_key VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, type VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL, payload JSONB NOT NULL, created_at TIMESTAMPTZ(3) NOT NULL DEFAULT (timezone('utc', now())) )
ALTER TABLE rule_management.outbox REPLICA IDENTITY FULL
